evidence: Both perl readers now print an ABORT message and exit 2 when opendir fails, which matches the commit's claim (diff lines 92 and 121).
The vault-copy check at diff line 143 dies before any counting when wiki/memory is missing or unreadable.

The project_list assignment with a guarded mapfile at diff lines 188-190 yields an empty array and reaches the existing 'no page of the vault names a project' die when there is no output. It also avoids hiding a perl failure the way process substitution did.
The pgrep pattern '[l]ongterm-mem.* sync' does not match its own command line, because the literal text '[l]ongterm-mem' does not match the regex. The self-excluding check works as described.
The relabelled '(no project, not counted per project)' key is only printed by the printf loop within the visible diff. I could not see any consumer that parses it, so I found no regression.
